title: Re-run the full 193-assertion acceptance, close every defect explicitly, and hand the tenant over as deliverable
goal: The program is only done when the same measurement that produced the 13 defects comes back clean. This wave re-runs all three suites against the fixed tree -- tenant_acceptance.py (136), ui_walkthrough.cjs (23) and cross_tenant_leak.py (34) -- and requires a verdict per defect rather than a single aggregate score: closed, downgraded with a written reason, or still open with a fix path. It also updates the acceptance report, STATUS.md and the changelog, archives W0..W5, and leaves the environment in a deliverable state (one clean tenant, no probe fixtures, no tenant_id = 0 rows produced by the console).
findings: All 13 defects from the baseline acceptance run must reach an explicit disposition; an aggregate pass rate is not an acceptable closeout signal.

out: Fixing defects that W1..W5 left open (they get a new task instead)
Re-cutting a foundation release unless sharedPaths changed

implementationNotes: Run the suites in a fixed order and from a clean fixture state: acceptance, then UI, then the leak probe, because the leak probe creates a tenant and leaves rows that would skew earlier counts.
Report per-defect disposition. '179/193 -> 193/193' hides which defect moved; the closeout table must map each F-id to closed/downgraded/open with the evidence path.
Verify the environment afterwards: exactly one deliverable tenant active, probe tenant archived, no tenant_id = 0 rows created by the console during the run.
If a defect is downgraded, the reason must be a product or scope decision recorded in the report, not 'acceptable for now'.

runtimeEvidence: per-defect disposition table with evidence paths
post-run SQL snapshot: zero rows in system_role_data_scope with tenant_id = 0 created during the run

humanGates: Accept the final verdict: deliverable, or deliverable-with-written-limitations, based on the per-defect table rather than the aggregate.
Confirm which P1/P2 items may ship open, and record that decision in the report.
completionChecklist: All three suites run in the fixed order from a clean fixture state
Every defect has a closed/downgraded disposition with an evidence path
Environment left deliverable: probe tenants archived, no ghost members, no tenant-0 grants on tenant roles
STATUS.md, CHANGELOG and the acceptance report updated
